solver.method_name: Genesis 1.3.3 proxy; simulator-grounded behavior verification with v5 representation adaptation and human-calibrated gates

representation_adaptation.routing: representation selection (object semantics first) drives solver routing; prior model_family overrides are recorded as metrics.mesh_adaptation.route_override
representation_adaptation.mpm_proxy: voxelize (pitch=max_extent/40) + interior fill + marching cubes; convex hull only as recorded fallback
representation_adaptation.garment_cloth: PBD stretch compliance 1e-7, bending projection off, self-collision on, dt=0.003s, substeps=10, local surface repair preferred

gate_calibration.settle_gate: off (demoted to diagnostic; human/systematic mismatch: 37/38 of settle_ratio>0.05 clips judged settled by all 10 experts)
gate_calibration.claim_wording_ceiling: bands sanity-checked against expert plausibility judgments (single-rater, n=150 core clips, 10 experts; Krippendorff alpha not estimable)
gate_calibration.offline_rejudge_evidence: pilot v2 (1000 tasks) re-judged with calibrated gates without re-simulation: verified 448 -> 475, zero regressions
gate_calibration.compression_deformation_min_note: The v12.6 lower bound max(0.02, 0.3*compression_ratio)=0.066 had not been human-calibrated. On 2026-09-24 the heldout videos of p0_tofu/p0_play_dough were manually reviewed (compression plate fully engaged, recovery~1.0, plausible behavior) and both were judged physically acceptable; the bound was lowered to 0.02, which still covers the fully-disengaged case. Basis: measured deformation 0.0522 (tofu) / 0.0643 (play_dough) plus engagement evidence.

carryover_from_v12.2_v12.3: heldout isolation (probe/action/config hashes differ, no feedback)
elastic budget (base 3, cap 8, +2 while loss improves >=5%)
five-state agent vocabulary -> three-state formal mapping; accepted_first_pass is not correction success
v12.3_fixes: yield_stress as the working dissipation channel (plastic_viscosity is a no-op in Genesis MPM)
PBD cloth substeps clamp <=8 superseded by v5 cloth numerics (dt=0.003, substeps=10)

claim_boundary: simulator-grounded behavior contract with human-sanity-checked gates; not measured material ground truth
simulation_calibrated_definition: frozen probe behavior contract passed under calibrated gates
